title: SaaS feature launch, 30 s (recipe)
summary: A 30 s, 900 f product launch built only from Library templates: feature title, chat, dropdown, modal, chart, KPI, toast, stat punch and CTA end card, with two slide wipes. Its transitions carry a keyed directional blur.
use_when: You need a short launch or feature-announcement video for a SaaS product and want a verified structure to swap your copy and UI into.
parameters: template copy (edit inside each placed template's comp)
carvercat_version: built and verified in Carvercat 0.1.6 (rev 1105,; public release binary, headless; packs added to the bundled Library for the test), 2026-10-27
copy_notes: No media; nothing to relink. Every scene is a Library template placed with library.place + template.apply; each placed template is a nested comp you can open and edit.
The packs listed in dependencies must be installed for library.place when you rebuild; the saved project already contains the placed comps.
Rebuild: ai/scripts/motion/recipes/rc_*.py (headless, isolated folders). Docs: ai/recipes/saas-feature-launch-30s.md.
Master lint 0 errors / 0 warnings / 0 notes; qc notes some long holds as freezes (see the doc).
source: Carvercat team, built with an AI agent, 2026-10-27
